newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan arrests Thai woman with heroin.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan arrests Thai woman with heroin.

text.p: Pakistani customs officials arrested a Thai woman at the Karachi airport on Tuesday with 6.6 kg (14.5 lbs) of heroin wrapped around her body, a Customs statement said.
It said the woman was arrested before she could board a morning flight to Muscat on her way to Addis Ababa. She has yet to be charged.
Changehamras was carrying 34 plastic rolls tied around her body and stuffed with 6.6 kg of off-white heroin powder, it said.
The maximum penalty for drug smuggling in Pakistan is death.
